# The Design of Everyday Things

By Norman.

The audiobook narrator is excellent. The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming. It changed how I run the weekly review.

I would give it four stars out of five. Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories. I read it on the train over two weeks, a chapter a day.

The main argument is that small habits compound over years. Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do. Not as good as the previous book by the same author.
